name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover washing machine leak damage?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover washing machine leak damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst washing machine hose. However, coverage can vary depending on your specific policy and the cause of the leak. Damage from neglected maintenance or gradual leaks might not be covered. It's important to review your policy details or contact your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage. We can help document the damage for your claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden water damage from appliance leaks. Check your specific policy for details on coverage.
